description: ParcelPal 1.2.4 remote-update edition. Wraps Scripting timers so WebView/background callbacks do not surface “Timer requires its active script on the main”; stamps sync failures with version and time; clears stale App Group failure records at sync start. Auth and keys unchanged.
name: 包裹助手（远程更新）

localizedDescriptions.zh: 1.2.4 远程更新版：安全包装会触发「Timer requires its active script on the main」的计时器；同步开始时清除旧失败记录，新失败带版本号和时间。登录与密钥逻辑未改。
localizedDescriptions.en: 1.2.4 remote-update edition. Safely wraps Scripting timers that can throw “Timer requires its active script on the main”; clears stale failure records at sync start and stamps new failures with version and time. Auth and keys unchanged.
